name: Citron Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon extract
ingredients.originalText: one teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon extract
ingredients.quantityText: one teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon extract

ingredients.name: heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder
ingredients.originalText: two heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder

ingredients.name: and a half of flour
ingredients.originalText: four cups and a half of flour

ingredients.name: and a half of citron
ingredients.originalText: one cup and a half of citron

instructions.text: Cream together three cups of white sugar and one cup of butter.
Add one cup of sweet milk and six eggs with whites and yolks beaten separately.
Add one teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon extract.
Sift two heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder with four cups and a half of flour and add.
Add one cup and a half of citron, sliced thin and dredged with flour.
Divide into two cakes and bake in tins lined with buttered letter paper.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream together three cups of white sugar and one cup of butter.
2. Add one cup of sweet milk and six eggs with whites and yolks beaten separately.
3. Add one teaspoonful of vanilla or lemon extract.
4. Sift two heaping teaspoonfuls of baking powder with four cups and a half of flour and add.
5. Add one cup and a half of citron, sliced thin and dredged with flour.
6. Divide into two cakes and bake in tins lined with buttered letter paper.
